overview: The Grimling Encampment is the fortified tribal camp of the Grimlings.
history: The encampment was built around ancient ritual pyres.
War tents expanded as Grimling raids intensified.
Supply pits were dug to support long warfront campaigns.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, Grimling warbands grew more aggressive.
Ritualists strengthened pyre rites to empower raiders.
hooks: A war tent collapses during preparation.
A Grimling warband leader rallies troops.
A supply pit reveals stolen goods.
